name: Shattered Strand
summary: Waves batter Shattered Strand along Azshara’s northern coast, where ancient ruins overlook the shore. Sea beasts and aquatic tribes prowl the shallows.

sections.title: A Treacherous Coastline
sections.body: The Shattered Strand runs along the northern edge of the Bay of Storms. Rocky beaches and tidal shallows teem with danger. Sea giants, hydras, and snapping makrura roam beside coastal murloc camps. Ruined elven buildings overlook the waves, including the ancient Temple of Arkkoran and the lone Tower of Eldara. Travelers who descend Azshara’s cliffs reach an isolated coast held by deadly amphibious creatures.

faq.q: Where is the Shattered Strand located?
faq.answer: The Shattered Strand runs along the northern coast of the Bay of Storms in eastern Azshara, beneath the zone’s high cliffs.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Shattered Strand?
faq.answer: Hydras, sea giants, makrura, and hostile murlocs prowl the shore and tidal flats.

faq.q: What notable ruins can be found along the beach?
faq.answer: The ancient Temple of Arkkoran and the nearby Tower of Eldara overlook the bay.

faq.q: Is the Shattered Strand safe for casual exploration?
faq.answer: No. The isolated beach lies below sheer cliffs and teems with predatory aquatic beasts and powerful giants, making a quick escape difficult.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can test yourself against hydras and other coastal beasts along this wild shore, or study the predatory wildlife of Kalimdor’s coast.
